title: Juniper Networks security advisory (AV26-1043)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1043 Date: October 15, 2026 As of October 14, 2026, Juniper Networks is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Junos OS Versions prior to 23.2R2-S7.7 Version 23.4 prior to 23.4R2-S8.13 Version 24.2 prior to 24.2R2-S5.5 Version 24.4 prior to 24.4R2-S5 Version 25.2 prior to 25.2R2-S2 Version 25.4 prior to 25.4R1-S3 Version 26.2 prior to 26.2R1-S2 Junos OS Evolved Versions prior to 23.2R2-S7.7-EVO Version 23.4 prior to 23.4R2-S8.11-EVO Version 24.2 prior to 24.2R2-S5.6-EVO Version 24.4 prior to 24.4R2-S5-EVO Version 25.2 prior to 25.2R2-S2-EVO Version 25.4 prior to 25.4R1-S3-EVO Version 26.2 prior to 26.2R1-S2-EVO Version 23.4X100-EVO Version 25.2X100 prior to 25.2X100-D35-EVO Version 25.4X300 prior to 25.4X300-D40-EVO The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. CEC Juniper Community CEC Juniper Community Article Link: Juniper Networks security advisory (AV26-1043) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
